prompt: From a ridge three kilometres off, a 300mm lens stacks it all together: silhouetted across the bottom, a row of semi-detached roofs and a lamp post; behind them the M1, six lanes of stopped cars with a few tiny figures walking between them; behind that a fuel depot near Hemel Hempstead, its white tanks bursting into domes of orange fire that feed one black plume filling the sky. Heat shimmer. Night in a near-future Britain, photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, inky blacks that stay black, no lens flare, no bloom. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no number plates, signs, logos or screen text.
